terbaru.judul: When large trades are not (automatically) news: liquidity tail risk and price discovery
terbaru.pelajaran: We examine how heavy-tailed liquidity demand changes price discovery in a sequential limit order book with asymmetric information.

terbaru.judul: Persona-Trained Monte Carlo: Estimating Market-Outcome Distributions via Swarms of Persona-Conditioned Neural Policy Bots in a Limit Order Book
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose Persona-Trained Monte Carlo (PTMC), a method for estimating distributions of market-outcome statistics by repeatedly simulating limit-order-book interaction among swarms of persona-conditioned neural-policy trading bots.

terbaru.judul: The Inference-Compute Frontier and a Latency-Efficient Architecture for Limit Order Book Prediction
terbaru.pelajaran: We study whether a scaling-law-style inference-compute frontier appears in limit order book prediction.

terbaru.judul: Trading in the Sunshine or in the Shade: Market Impact and Adverse Selection on Hyperliquid
terbaru.pelajaran: We study Hyperliquid, a fully on-chain limit order book for cryptocurrency perpetual futures, where protocol-native TWAP orders disclose their terms from inception and remain visible while active, a natural form of sunshine trading.

terbaru.judul: Correlation emergence and the Epps effect in two coupled limit order books
terbaru.pelajaran: We give a unified analytic account of correlation emergence and the Epps effect in two coupled limit order books.

terbaru.pelajaran: We study an online market-making problem in which a learner sequentially posts bid and ask prices for a single asset while interacting with traders holding private valuations.
